title: Wiki content
description: Text and media shown in the in-app help wiki. Edit this file to change the guide without touching code.

screens.description: One guide page per app screen. Shown in the left navigation, in this order.

id.description: Unique id. Use welcome/rooms/items/review/export to link the '▶ Revoir les bulles' button to that app screen.

nav.description: Short label shown in the left navigation.

kicker.description: Small orange label above the title (e.g. 'Étape 1').

icon.description: Emoji shown next to the nav label.

image.description: Optional screenshot filename in public/assets/wiki/. Defaults to screen-<id>.png.

video.description: Optional video filename in public/assets/wiki/. Defaults to video-<id>.mp4.

showReplayTour.description: Show the '▶ Revoir les bulles de cet écran' button. Defaults to true for welcome/rooms/items/review/export.

blocks.description: Numbered explanation points, in order. Add a step by adding an item.

t.description: The explanation that follows the dash.

image.description: Optional image filename in public/assets/wiki/, shown under this step (e.g. 'rooms-step-1.png').

video.description: Optional video filename in public/assets/wiki/, shown under this step.

caption.description: Optional small caption under this step's image/video.

steps.description: The '🧭 Le pas-à-pas' section: the whole journey in a few steps.

trouble.description: The '🛟 En cas de problème' section.
